title: Branching timelines, duplicate selves, and cross-branch knowledge

characters.name: Ilya Cross
characters.goals: Change the Beta branch access code

finding.title: Rowan knows a code created only in another branch
finding.summary: Ilya creates CEDAR-9 only in Branch Beta, while the rules block memory transfer, but Rowan uses it in Branch Alpha without receiving a message.
finding.question: How does Rowan know CEDAR-9 in Branch Alpha under the stated branch-isolation rules?
finding.conflicting_fact_a: The new code CEDAR-9 exists only in Branch Beta, and memories do not cross branches.
finding.conflicting_fact_b: Rowan enters CEDAR-9 in Branch Alpha without any shown transmission.
finding.inference_explanation: The draft establishes no message, shared memory, or other cross-branch evidence before Rowan uses the code.

evidence.quote: Ilya overwrites PINE-4 with CEDAR-9. Only the Beta card now carries CEDAR-9.
evidence.location: INT. VAULT ANTECHAMBER - BRANCH BETA - JUNE 3 - 7:50 A.M.

evidence.quote: No transmission arrives. Rowan types CEDAR-9 into the Alpha console.
evidence.location: INT. MISSION CONTROL - BRANCH ALPHA - JUNE 3 - 8:05 A.M.

revisions.script:
[scene]INT. MISSION CONTROL - BRANCH ALPHA - JUNE 3 - 8:00 A.M.
[action]The jump rules fill the wall: EACH JUMP CREATES A SEPARATE BRANCH AT THE DESTINATION. EVENTS DO NOT REWRITE THE ORIGIN BRANCH. MEMORIES DO NOT CROSS BRANCHES. A RETURN BEACON CAN SEND ONE RECORDED MESSAGE TO THE ORIGIN BRANCH.
[action]Ilya shows Rowan an access card marked PINE-4, then enters the gate without speaking.
[scene]INT. VAULT ANTECHAMBER - BRANCH BETA - JUNE 3 - 7:50 A.M.
[action]Ilya lands beside her younger Beta self, who still holds an intact access card marked PINE-4. The two Ilyas face each other.
[action]Ilya overwrites PINE-4 with CEDAR-9. Only the Beta card now carries CEDAR-9.
